project.title: MES Acceptance H-CONTROL
project.description:
Create an 8 second narrated documentary montage at EXACTLY 24 fps using only real open motion footage from NASA and/or Wikimedia Commons. Use the supplied narration, trimmed to the 8 second timeline. Music is explicitly opted out, so the mix is narration only. Honour the supplied locked timeline: 24 fps and the two locked scene boundaries. Fill each locked gap scene with real motion footage. Do not use still-image substitutes, fixtures, generated video, Pexels, or Pixabay. No editable project export is requested for this run.

This run exercises MES process control: it will be paused and resumed, a duplicate start will be attempted and must be rejected, and the production will then be cancelled. Checkpoint whatever is complete before yielding.
